$comment: Bear Trap rally mechanics. The rules below are taken from community guides and drive every recommendation on the Bear Trap page. NO HERO STATS ARE SHIPPED — hero skill values are read off your own game screen, because they differ by hero level, star and gear and are exactly the kind of thing that goes stale.

mechanics.title: The Bear deals no damage
mechanics.detail: There is nothing to tank, so infantry and lancers earn their slot only if you have no marksmen left to send. Marksmen out-damage everything else.

mechanics.title: A rally leader's three heroes all count
mechanics.detail: Every Expedition Skill on all three of the leader's heroes feeds the rally buff — up to nine skills with three mythic heroes. Slot order does not matter for the leader.

mechanics.title: Only the first four joiners buff the rally
mechanics.detail: The first four players to join contribute their LEAD hero's 1st Expedition Skill and nothing else. Which hero sits in slot one is the entire decision for those four.

mechanics.title: After the fourth joiner, heroes stop mattering
mechanics.detail: Later joiners add no buffs at all. Their heroes should simply be the highest level they own, because hero level raises how many troops the march carries.

mechanics.title: Heroes never damage the Bear themselves
mechanics.detail: Heroes only buff troops. A strong hero with a weak march is worth less than a modest hero carrying a full load of high-tier marksmen.

skillTypes.name: Troop Defence / Health up
skillTypes.note: The Bear deals no damage, so survivability skills add nothing here.

skillTypes.name: March / rally capacity up
skillTypes.note: No direct damage, but a bigger march carries more marksmen.

suggestedHeroes.note: Names players commonly bring to Bear Trap rallies. UNVERIFIED and deliberately carrying no stats — add the ones you own and read their real skill values off your own hero screen.
